::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 16th [1862]  
**From:** Ottery  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection, CO171: Box 29
:::

My dear [Sir](people/person_1144.qmd),

I did not mean to publish the two volumes of the [History of Christian Names](cmy_books/cmybook_48.qmd) separately.[^1] The second is in a state of forwardness, but I thought I had explained when I saw you that I thought it would save time to have the 1st in the press while I am going over the 2nd again.

I imagine 2000 copies will be sufficient for a first edition.

My direction till the 20th will be the [Revd W Butler](people/person_244.qmd)’s

						  Vicarage

							Wantage	

Yours faithfully

C.M. Yonge

---

[^1]: It was published in two volumes by Parker, Son and Bourn in 1863.  This letter may perhaps have been addressed to [William Butler Bourn](people/person_178.qmd) rather than the elder Parker.
